name: site-settings
description: Editable site-wide settings global (name, SEO defaults, socials) + getSettings() helper
postInstall:
Manual edit required. Open src/payload.config.ts and:
  1. import Settings from "@/globals/Settings"
  2. add `globals: [Settings]` to the buildConfig() call (or append to existing globals array)

Then run `pnpm db:migrate:create site-settings` and `pnpm db:migrate`.

Use it in pages/layouts via:
  import { getSettings } from "@/lib/settings";
  const settings = await getSettings();
